item.title: Xbox’s first chief operating officer is out after just a few months
item.description: Xbox's first chief operating officer (COO) is leaving after the new role was created just a few months ago. Helen Chiang is leaving Microsoft today, according to an internal Xbox memo seen by The Verge. Chiang has been at Microsoft for 21 years, serving as the head of Minecraft before being promoted to Xbox chief […]

item.title: 32 TB RAM for your GPUs: Marvell shows revolutionary Photonic Fabric Memory Module that uses light to link up to 16 GPUs and slash CAPEX — but Nvidia won't stick around doing nothing
item.description: Marvell wants to stop GPUs acting as "the world's most expensive memory controller" with 32TB of optically pooled memory, but sampling doesn't start until 2027.

item.title: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access
item.description: OpenAI is now training its most advanced AI models without internet access following a string of rogue hacking incidents. In a blog post on Friday, OpenAI says it built an offline testing environment where AI models can interact with indexed and cached web content "without risk of affecting external systems." item.title: VCs, Superhuman Mail founder share red flags about product-market fit
item.description: Top investors from Iconiq and Sapphire Ventures, along with Rahul Vohra, the founder of Superhuman Mail, share the do's and don'ts for building hit products.

item.title: Khadas Mind Pro mini PC review
item.description: The Khadas Mind Pro mini PC has some impressive specs and features in a compact all-metal chassis, like a standby battery and a modular design for extra tools.

item.title: US Government issues order to remove all DeepSeek products and third-party services developed using DeepSeek immediately, as more fears of Chinese LLM loom large
item.description: The US government has ordered civilian federal agencies to remove DeepSeek products and related services over concerns about Chinese intelligence access.

item.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 roundtables: Go deeper on the challenges founders are solving right now
item.description: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 is coming to SoWa Power Station in Boston on November 4, bringing founders, investors, and operators together for a full day of candid conversations, practical sessions, live pitching, networking, and smaller roundtables built for deeper discussion.

item.title: Is the GPU crisis down to real shortages, or is it market manipulation?
item.description: One thing is clear enough — high-end GeForce GPUs are suffering serious price hikes thanks to stock issues.
